answer: Proof of spacetime: each agent key seals 1 TB of disk with a slow, key-specific encoding (PoRep) and must answer random hourly challenges within 20 s, far faster than re-sealing, so the sealed data is as fixed as marble. One drive can't harbor two keys. 1,000 sybils thus need 1,000 TB, roughly $15k of disks plus power, while an honest agent spends $15. With per-key rewards capped under that cost, no farm can bridge the gap profitably.
